prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: editorial website photograph for a private guitar practice section, expressing an hour of calm personal time.
Primary request: An accurate classical nylon-string Spanish guitar resting securely on a simple discreet stand beside an empty wooden chair in a quiet home corner. No people.
Scene/backdrop: Calm uncluttered domestic room, warm off-white plaster wall, soft muted smoked-plum linen curtain at a window, a little warm wooden floor. One small open notebook and a pencil lie on the chair seat. No other decorative props.
Subject: Natural honey-wood classical guitar with round rosette, traditional slotted headstock and six tuning pegs, exactly six strings, believable frets and body proportions; ordinary curved-back wooden chair beside it.
Style/medium: Realistic editorial interior photograph, tactile and unpretentious, subtle photographic grain.
Composition/framing: Landscape 3:2, wider environmental view, complete guitar visible with breathing room above and below, chair and guitar form a balanced quiet composition around the center. Eye-level camera. Modest negative space, no staged product-display look.
Lighting/mood: Soft late-morning window daylight, gentle shadows and a restful intimate mood, natural dynamic range.
Color palette: Muted plum linen, warm paper wall, honey wood, restrained soft brass warmth, subtle lavender-gray shadows.
Constraints: No people, no hands, no readable text, no logos or branding, no watermark. This is a conceptual atmospheric photograph, not a claimed real photograph of a specific musician's actual home or studio. Correct guitar anatomy and perspective. No CGI, no oversaturated orange light, no dramatic spotlight, no excessive objects.
